metas.name: Gen 4 Black Car
metas.note: Black car can be hard to see depending on the driving surface. It is quite sparse and doesn't appear often. (see second image for an example of black car)

metas.name: Gen 4 No Car No Antenna
metas.note: no car no antenna is the most common gen 4 car and appears in many places.

metas.name: Gen 4 No Car With Antenna
metas.note:
Gen 4 no car with antenna is sparse. Most prominently it covers the long road between Yaroslavl - Kirov - Perm - Chelyabinsk.

While quite reliable, the antenna sometimes can be blurred out and it appears like 'no car no antenna' - that's just bad luck for you then :(

metas.name: Gen 4 Red Car
metas.note: Red car is usually easier to recognize than black or white car

metas.name: Gen 4 White Car
metas.note: White car can be hard to see and probably takes some practice to spot, sometimes it just isn't really visible. It mostly appears in the far east in Sakha and Magadan which are luckily quite recognizable by vibes. (see third image for an example of white car)

metas.name: Short Antenna B Type
metas.note:
B-type is the most common type of short antenna.

Learning camera smudge metas can be especially helpful for b-type:

YT tutorial by SwordSlicer56

Google doc by Illusion

metas.name: Short Antenna B Type Pronounced
metas.note: B-type pronounced, also referred to as 'very b-type' can sometimes be confused with normal b-type. To differenciate the two it helps to know that b-type pronounced will never have smudges, which normal b-type has a lot.

metas.name: Short Antenna Blurred
metas.note: The second most common type of short antenna
metas.footer: ⓘ check the other image(s) by using the arrows

metas.name: Short Antenna Blurred Tilted
metas.note: Blurred tilted is either around st. petersburg or around volgograd, which looks so different that it is a easy 50/50. You don't get blurred tilted often. To be sure of the tilt line up the antenna with the bottom middle of your screen, you then should be able to see the tilt to the left.
